baseline_models.focus_anchor: The faith-spend pairing at 57:7.1/4/10/12 and mustakhlafina at 57:7.7.
baseline_models.mechanism: Heart-settled trust plus an assigned successor-status makes possession a temporary office; expenditure is that office's outward performance rather than disposal of absolute property.

activation_trace.role: Security and trust make faith the inward acceptance of entrusted responsibility.
Making something occupy a condition supplies the assignment into trustee-status.
One thing succeeding and standing for another defines possession as delegated tenure.
Money leaving in expenditure is the visible act required by that tenure.

changed_reading.before: Believe and give from one's possessions.
changed_reading.after: Accept the trust and release some of what one holds only by assigned, successor-tenure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Anfiq at 57:7.4/12, mustakhlafina at 57:7.7, and ajr at 57:7.14.
baseline_models.mechanism: The apparent exhaustion of spending is crossed by the image of a passage with an outlet; succession places that exit inside a replacement-chain, while reward relocates the final accounting beyond the present holder's balance.

activation_trace.role: A thing going away or being exhausted supplies spending's felt loss.
A tunnel with an outlet recasts loss as movement through an open route.
Alternating succession places each holder and holding in a temporal chain.
Return for work supplies an answering value beyond the immediate outflow.

changed_reading.before: Spending simply reduces what the giver has.
changed_reading.after: Spending opens a route through transient holdings: depletion for one holder becomes circulation across succession, with recompense beyond the immediate balance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated divine dominion removes absolute human title, and inheritance supplies transfer from predecessor to successor; mustakhlafina therefore names an interim station in an ownership-chain whose encompassing owner is God.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign dominion supplies the ownership frame that precedes the focus command.
Inheritance moving from a predecessor to an heir supplies the transfer-chain.
Standing in another's place anchors that transfer-chain in mustakhlafina.

structural_cues: 57:2 and 57:5 repeat divine dominion; 57:10 places God's inheritance of heavens and earth inside the renewed spending appeal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine dominion, inheritance-transfer, and successor-status; I infer a tenure chain in which spending routes entrusted goods onward. A live alternative is that inheritance only emphasizes God's final ownership, without assigning a human transfer-duty.

changed_reading.before: Mustakhlafina could mean possessors empowered to give.
changed_reading.after: They are interim holders inside a transfer-chain; spending honors a tenure that neither began nor ends with them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby loan image defines giving as a deliberate cut from capital that is due an answering return, and doubling makes the return generative rather than merely compensatory.

activation_trace.role: A cut of wealth or work whose recompense returns turns expenditure into purposeful severance, not disappearance.
Increase by another like amount supplies the generative response to that severance.
Exhaustion supplies the loss that the loan mechanism revises.
Recompense for work anchors the promised return in the focus ayah.

structural_cues: 57:11 immediately follows the renewed spending appeal with a good loan, multiplication, and a noble reward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cut made for return and increase by a like amount; I infer that outward movement is not net loss in the verse's accounting. The live alternative is a promissory metaphor that assures reward without describing a causal circulation.

changed_reading.before: The great reward compensates a giver after an irreversible subtraction.
changed_reading.after: The released portion enters a promised return-cycle in which the cut itself becomes the site of increase.

context_deltas.mechanism: The n-f-q inventory contrasts open financial exit with a displayed entrance and concealed exit. When 57:13 names hypocrites inside a wall-door, inner-outer scene, spending becomes a material congruence test: declared faith should produce an open, accountable outflow rather than preserve a hidden route.

activation_trace.role: The shown entrance and concealed exit supplies the context's counter-pattern of split allegiance.
Openly sending money out supplies the materially visible alternative to concealment.
Heart-settling assent anchors the demand for consistency between profession and material conduct.

structural_cues: 57:13 places the hypocrites amid a wall, a door, an inside, and an outside, making split access spatially explicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two n-f-q branch images and the inner-outer architecture; I infer that expenditure tests whether faith has a concealed material exit. The live alternative is that 57:13's architecture is only an eschatological boundary, not a lens on 57:7's spending command.

changed_reading.before: Faith and spending are adjacent obligations.
changed_reading.after: Open expenditure is evidence that professed faith has no concealed economic exit; the two imperatives test one another.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hoarding is the explicit inverse of expenditure, while divine self-sufficiency removes any supplying deficit. Spending therefore discloses the holder's fidelity to the trust rather than meeting a need in God.

activation_trace.role: Miserly withholding supplies the direct behavioral inverse of anfiq.
Independence and freedom from need remove any divine shortage as the reason for spending.
The exit of money becomes the observable disclosure opposed to withholding.

structural_cues: 57:24 joins those who hoard and command hoarding to the declaration that God is self-sufficient and praiseworthy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the withholding-inverse and divine independence; I infer that the command diagnoses the trustee rather than supplies the owner. The live alternative is that divine self-sufficiency serves only as a closing doxology.

changed_reading.before: Spending transfers resources to a recipient who lacks them.
changed_reading.after: Because the ultimate owner lacks nothing, spending primarily reveals whether the temporary holder will enact or obstruct the trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: Balance, collective rising, and equitable division place resources inside a public ordering mechanism. Delegated wealth is not only privately donated; its circulation helps people stand within a measured distribution.

activation_trace.role: A balance of justice supplies the standard governing resource movement.
Rising with resolve to a matter supplies collective enactment rather than private sentiment.
Share and division supply the distributive operation within justice.
Successor-tenure identifies who bears the temporary distributive office.
Money leaving the holder is the focus ayah's means for enacting that office.

structural_cues: 57:25 aligns book, balance, people's standing in equity, iron, and public benefits in one institutional sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public standing, a justice-balance, equitable shares, and useful material; I infer that delegated expenditure can maintain a just social order. The live alternative is that 57:25 concerns institutions generally without specifying 57:7's expenditure.

changed_reading.before: The command concerns individual generosity from entrusted property.
changed_reading.after: The command also recruits temporary holders into the measured circulation by which a community can stand in equity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following along predecessor-traces turns successor-status into a historical relay. Belief in the messenger and expenditure can then be read together as carrying both message and material means beyond the current station.

activation_trace.role: Following a trace in sequence supplies the relay's ordered movement.
The second mapped inventory's trace-following independently reinforces the tracking mechanism.
A remaining mark supplies what a predecessor leaves for a follower.
The split inventory's movement from place supplies activation of the residue rather than passive preservation.
Standing after another anchors the relay in mustakhlafina.
Messenger and carried message identify the relay to which faith is attached.

structural_cues: 57:27 twice marks following, explicitly places it on predecessors' traces, and links the sequence to messengers before returning to faith and reward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sequential trace-following, residual marks, successor-status, and messenger-language; I infer that entrusted means help carry a historical witness onward. The live alternative is that economic succession in 57:7 and prophetic succession in 57:27 remain separate domains.

changed_reading.before: Mustakhlafina describes the present community's relation to property.
changed_reading.after: It can also place the community at one relay-station, charged to pass both witness and enabling means beyond itself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports the technical kh-l-f water-drawing branch into an economic imperative; it remains anchored in mustakhlafina and is sharpened by 57:25's share/division branch. Render it only as a material analogy for turn-bound access, not as the lexical meaning governing the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Mustakhlafina at 57:7.7, joined to anfiq at 57:7.4/12.

activation_trace.role: Alternating water-drawers literalize succession as turn-bound access to a common source.
Share and division supply the equitable allocation that disciplines each turn.
Money leaving the holder translates the shared-source analogy into the focus command's action.

changed_reading.before: A successor controls an entrusted stock for a time.
changed_reading.after: A successor resembles one of several water-drawers: the turn grants access and imposes passage onward, so expenditure prevents a temporary draw from becoming capture.

strongest_changes: Divine dominion plus inheritance changed successor-status from broad stewardship into temporary tenure within a transfer-chain.
Loan-cut plus doubling changed expenditure from net depletion into released value whose accounting returns amplified.
The shared n-f-q inventory and 57:13's inside-outside architecture made open spending a diagnostic opposite to concealed exit.
Balance, collective rising, and equitable division widened spending from personal charity to maintenance of a just public order.
summary.what_was_special: The same n-f-q inventory could stage wealth's open exit, apparent exhaustion, a through-passage, and hypocrisy's concealed exit, while kh-l-f supplied succession, alternation, and turn-taking. Those branch contrasts produced several coexisting mechanisms rather than one paraphrase.
remaining_uncertainties: The tunnel, concealed-exit, and water-turn readings are branch-driven analogies, not claims that those senses govern the surface syntax.
The context supports public-equity and historical-relay readings but does not specify which concrete expenditures instantiate them.
